data.title: 陈千语 · 营地帐篷的微火独处
data.description: 塔卫二冰冷刺骨的荒野黑夜里，简易保温帐篷内跳动着小型发热炉的橙红微光。千语卸下了厚重的防风护甲，只穿着贴身的无袖黑色背心。火光映红了她坚毅而优美的下颌线与锁骨，她倒了半杯温茶递过去，低声诉说着白日未言的关切。
data.action: sitting cross-legged, tank top, offering warm tea cup, campfire glow
data.lighting: warm glowing camp heater illuminating shadows
data.promptProse: Inside an insulated exploration tent on a freezing wasteland, Chen Qianyu rests without her bulky armor in a fitted black sleeveless tank top. The glowing orange heater highlights her sculpted shoulders and collarbone as she hands over a cup of warm tea.
data.animaCaption: Qianyu resting comfortably in a warm wasteland tent in her tank top.
